title: Innokin Kwik 35K Blueberry Sour Raspberry Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Blueberry Sour Raspberry pairs juicy Blueberry with a sharp Raspberry edge for a bright, balanced berry flavour that stays consistent. Each pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and 10ml refill container for the Innokin Kwik 35K device. The mesh-coil and dual-chamber auto-feed system deliver clear flavour and steady vapour throughout Explore all our flavours with the complete selection of Innokin Kwik 35k Pods . How to Set Up Innokin Kwik 35K Prefilled Pod Step 1 Insert the prefilled pod into the Kwik 35K device until it clicks. Step 2 Fit the 10ml refill container securely into the base compartment. Step 3 Inhale on the mouthpiece to vape. Replace the pod pack once both chambers are empty. ✅ You're all set!
